auth.invalidCredentials: Check your username and password and try again.
auth.unavailable: Unable to sign in. Please try again.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
auth.signOutFailed: Unable to sign out. Please try again.
auth.signOutCleanupFailed: Your session ended, but local data could not be removed. Close other application tabs, then choose Sign out again to retry cleanup.

storage.ready: Local storage is ready in this browser.
storage.offlineReady: The application is ready for offline use on this browser.
storage.blocked: Local storage is waiting for another tab. Close other Benchline Stats tabs and app windows to allow initialization to continue.
storage.closed: Local storage was closed, possibly by an update in another tab. Reload when you are ready, or try opening storage again. Existing data has not been reset.
storage.unsupported: Local storage is unavailable in this browser. Use a browser that supports IndexedDB and allows site storage.
storage.failed: Local storage could not be initialized. Check available space and this browser's site-storage settings, then try again. Existing data has not been reset.

persistence.persistent: Persistent storage is enabled. Clearing site data or losing this device can still remove local records.
persistence.bestEffort: Persistent storage was not granted. Local storage works, but this browser may remove it when space is low.
persistence.unsupported: This browser cannot request persistent storage. Local storage works, but the browser manages how long it is retained.
persistence.failed: Persistent storage could not be checked or requested. Local storage works, but protection against browser eviction is unconfirmed.

pwa.title: Benchline Stats
pwa.description: Manage players and teams. Match tools will follow in a later update.
pwa.preparing: Preparing application files for offline use…
pwa.failed: Application files could not be saved for offline use. Reconnect and try again.
pwa.unsupported: Offline installation is unavailable in this browser. Use a supported browser over a secure connection.
pwa.development: Offline installation is disabled during development.
pwa.updateAvailable: An update is ready. Close all Benchline Stats tabs and app windows, then reopen when you are ready to update.

players.title: Players
players.description: Manage the players available for your teams.
players.emptyDescription: Choose New to add your first player.
players.noMatchesDescription: Try another name or clear your search.
players.newDescription: Add a player by name. You can assign them to a team later.
players.name: Name
players.unavailableDescription: This player was not found in the data stored on this device.
players.storageNotice: Players are saved on this device and sync when you are connected and signed in. Signing out removes all local data, including players that have not synced.
players.loadFailed: Could not read the player data. Try again. Existing records have not been removed.
players.saveFailed: The player could not be saved. Your name is still here. Try creating the player again.

appHome.title: Home
appHome.playersDescription: Browse players and view their details.
appHome.teamsDescription: Browse teams and view their details.
appHome.matchesDescription: Create matches and follow the action.

localAccount.title: Set up this device
localAccount.signInRequired: Connect to the internet and sign in once to use this device. After setup, you can create and view players and teams offline.
localAccount.failed: Setup could not be completed. Check your connection and local storage, then try again. Existing players have been kept.
localAccount.importDescription: This device has {count, plural, one {# prototype player} other {# prototype players}} without an owner. Import them into {account}?
localAccount.deferred: Your players have been kept. Import them to finish setup and use Players.

sync.title: Synchronization
sync.offline: Offline. Your data stays on this device and will sync when you reconnect.
sync.signIn: Sign in to sync. You can continue using Players and Teams offline.
sync.mismatch: The signed-in account does not match this device’s local account. Sync is paused. Sign out to remove this local dataset before using another account.
sync.unsupported: Sync requires a browser with Web Locks over a secure connection. Your data remains saved on this device.
sync.failed: Sync could not finish. Your local data has been kept. We will retry, or you can try now.
sync.blocked: Some records need attention before they can sync.
sync.pending: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}
sync.blockedCount: {count, plural, one {# change could not sync} other {# changes could not sync}}. Automatic retries for these changes are paused. They remain on this device and will be removed if you sign out.
sync.recordBlocked: Saved on this device · Needs attention
